locked.text: You! You're not one of them. Get me out of here! The lock's on the west side; they've the key, but it's a cheap lock. Work it. Quickly, before the big one comes back.

choices.text: (Merchant) Jory! It's me. Where's the strongbox?

locked_merchant.text: You came back for me? Gods. They took the box to their chest, by the tents. They couldn't open it. Get me out first, please.

locked_who.text: Jory Vell. I drive for a merchant off the coast. They ran us into the ditch on the north road, took the mules, and dragged me here to wait for a ransom nobody's going to pay.

freed.text: The door's open. Thank the road. I'm not stopping to thank you properly; I'll be at the waystation, Maren knows me. They put the strongbox in their chest by the tents, if you're feeling brave.
